title: Love is a Wonderful Thing
lyrics_plain:
Birds fly they don't think twice They simply spread their wings
The sun shines it don't ask why Or what the whole thing means
The same applies to you and I We never question that
So good it's just understood Ain't no conjecture Just a matter of fact
Love is a wonderful thing
Make ya smile through the pouring rain
Love is a wonderful thing
I'll say it again and again
Turn your world into one sweet dream
Take your heart and make it sing
Love love is a wonderful thing
The only thing a river knows Is runnin' to the sea
And every spring when a flower grows It happens naturally
The same magic when you're in my arms No logic can define
Don't know why, just feels so right I only know it happens every time
Love is a wonderful thing
Make ya smile through the pouring rain
Love is a wonderful thing
I'll say it again and again
Turn your world into one sweet dream
Take your heart and make it sing
Love love is a wonderful thing
Oh when the cold wind blows I know you're gonna be there to warm me

Just keep growin'

Love is a wonderful
